messages:
ari: quick huddle — short UX pass on the request drilldown. two bits: export CTA placement and correlation-ID chip/tab order. can we decide before EOD? maya: saw the mock. export CTA sits left of the corr-id chip and it reads like primary action. feels noisy. prefer moving export to kebab or secondary. jordan: +1 move to kebab. also SR/keyboard order: screen readers hit export before they hear the corr id; they miss the identifier. recommend corr-id earlier in DOM. sam: current tab order is header -> export -> corr chip -> details. suggested change: header -> corr chip -> actions -> details. minimal DOM reorder will fix many use-cases. lee: contrast nit: corr chip bg @ current token has 2.8:1 against white. needs 4.5:1 for normal text. either darken bg or add outline. a11y-bot: automated check: corr-chip contrast ratio 2.78:1. recommended AA swap to #2b3a4f or add 2px 1.5mm focus ring for keyboard users. maya: copy tweak — current button label says `Export trace`. users have confused that with downloading raw artifacts. alternative suggestions: `Download snapshot` or `Export trace (JSON)` if file format matters. jordan: For SR labels: `aria-label="Correlation ID: — copy button"` and use a polite live region for copy confirmation (`Copied correlation id`). Also consider adding `aria-describedby` that points to a short hint: "Use Copy to copy ID to clipboard". sam: small code suggestion for the copy button pattern so the SR announcement is deterministic: ```
``` ari: good. also debate: keep small standalone copy icon next to corr id, and keep permalink in same affordance? or combine into overflow? thoughts? maya: combine copy + permalink into a single popover would reduce clutter. quick actions: Copy, Open permalink, Share. Export stays in kebab as secondary. lee: agree on popover. ensures we can add keyboard shortcuts later. also add tooltip text that appears on focus (not just hover) for a11y. jordan: one more: ensure exported file naming uses `trace-.json` so users can match artifacts back. small but helpful. ari: great, i'll update the mock: move export into kebab, corr chip earlier in DOM, implement popover for copy/permalink, update colors for contrast, and apply SR labels/live-region. i'll post updated frames in #design once ready. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
